paragraphs: A High Priest in the Second Temple. In Pesachim 57a they said of him that he was a glutton, and that in all his days no leftover [sacrificial meat] was found in the Temple.[^1]

notes.text: כה״ג is contextually High Priest in the Second Temple, without adding a Rabbi title or canonical identity. נז. gives Pesachim 57a by the period convention, without fresh edition verification. They said of him preserves the source’s report; glutton and the negation throughout all his days are retained. Sacrificial meat is an explicit bracketed contextual gloss for נותר, not separately supplied words.
